Suncor Energy Inc. (2025). Suncor Firebag In Situ Project: 2024 Directive 54 Performance Report. Commercial Scheme Approval No. 8870. Reporting period 1 January to 31 December 2024. Annual performance presentation filed with the Alberta Energy Regulator, 30 June 2025.

Loaded: 2024 scheme bitumen production (annual-output from the printed 37,165 m3/d x 366 d), steam per m3 bitumen (flow, from the printed 97,303 m3/d steam), descriptions for the scheme, the NCG co-injection variant and the Pad 131 ES-SAGD demonstration. Other-values: SOR 2.62, design capacities read from the slide 28 chart, 4 cogeneration units (from a compliance event), Pad 131 co-injection concentration and printed 40% oil-uplift label. The deck follows the revised Directive 054 template (2025): it has no energy-balance, fuel-gas, electricity, cogeneration, GHG, water-balance or steam-generator slides, so no specific-energy-consumption, emissions or water-treatment rows could be written. Skipped: subsurface, geomechanics, seismic, well suspension, regulatory and compliance tables. Locator convention: slide numbers, printed on each slide and equal to PDF pages. Traps: (1) reporting year is 2024 although the file is named 2025; (2) leap year, 366 days; (3) design capacity is under internal reassessment by Suncor and the chart line sits below actual production; (4) operator legal name (Suncor Energy Inc.) is not printed, only "Suncor".
